lane_single_method: PROV-CREST de-novo emission: composite Hessian crest of organizer-provided training_features.tif Bands 19/3/18/15 (weights 0.45/0.20/0.20/0.15 after percentile ranking), 1-D directional NMS crest pool, exactly 37,654 binary dots selected de novo (zero R0/sibling dots by construction) at >=3.5 px mutual spacing and >3.0 px from the catalogue (full catalogue for the shipped file; visible-only catalogue inside each holdout fold). No external data, no sibling supports (no H19-5/H19-4/H16-1), no catalogue-derived ranking field.

EXP1_provcrest_rank.selection: greedy descending composite-crest score, accept if >=3.5 px from every already accepted dot (deterministic row-major tie-break)
EXP1_provcrest_rank.predicted_holdout_dti_vs_r0_control: MODEL:+0.03 to +0.10 (crest lines coincide with withheld fault scarps/contacts; R0 control is expected near 0.004 because its dots sit >2 px from all catalogue pixels including withheld truth)
EXP1_provcrest_rank.falsifier: Pooled HOLDOUT-DTI (seeds 20+30) not above R0 control, or paired 95% CI includes 0, or blind SGMC PROXY below R0 0.096060

CONTROL_r0.selection: R0 (h33-h33-2-b2, 37,654 dots) evaluated unchanged on identical folds
CONTROL_r0.role: benchmark only, not an experiment and not a candidate

EXP2_provcrest_randorder.selection: seeded random order (numpy default_rng 20261024) over the identical crest pool, identical >=3.5 px blocked-greedy acceptance, budget and collar; zero crest-score ranking
EXP2_provcrest_randorder.predicted_holdout_dti_vs_rank: MODEL:-0.01 to +0.02 vs EXP1 (IR-88-55 novelty-radius finding predicts ranking adds little; crest-score ranking is retained only if it beats this control)
EXP2_provcrest_randorder.falsifier: If EXP2 >= EXP1 on pooled HOLDOUT-DTI, score ranking is retired and EXP2 ships; if both <= R0 control, verdict is negative and nothing ships as promotable
EXP2_provcrest_randorder.note: Amended 2026-10-24 before any build/scoring: replaces farthest-point EXP2 (O(n_add x n_pool) exact maximin is not computable for 37,654 picks over the full crest pool within budget); farthest-point remains Rank-2 hypothesis for a future capped-pool test. Random-order is the preregistered ranking falsifier used by IR-88-55 at refill scale.

gates.validator: no NaN/Inf anywhere (zeros outside footprint, nodata=None), values subset of {0.0,1.0} in [0,1], EPSG:32611, 3730x3292, transform identical to sample_submission.tif, 0 dots on catalogue, min distance to catalogue >3.0 px
gates.promotion_rule: Ship only the holdout-winning arm; verdict promote only if it beats R0 control on pooled HOLDOUT-DTI with paired 95% CI excluding 0 AND passes uniqueness + validator gates. Otherwise verdict negative, file still downloadable but labelled DO NOT SUBMIT.

non_fault_mimic: Unfaulted coalescing alluvial-fan bajada toe inflections, incised fluvial terrace risers, Tertiary volcanic flow margins and pluton-roof contacts producing slope-break / gradient crests without brittle fault permeability.
